Definition: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or become king or queen, reign; 1a) (Qal) to be or become king or queen, reign; 1b) (Hiphil) to make one king or queen, cause to reign; 1c) (Hophal) to be made king or queen; 2) to counsel, advise; 2a) (Niphal) to consider
